text: You have no idea what it is like to have to live there for years...

speaker: Juhani
text: To walk down the streets. To have people look at you in disgust; like an animal. Most did not know anything about me, but it was there all the same.

speaker: Juhani
text: Because I was an 'alien'. Because I was different from them; frightening.

speaker: Juhani
text: I doubt any of them had even seen my people before. So they persecuted me...

speaker: Juhani
text: They looked down on me and my family. Charged us more for food. Would not let us walk their streets. They spat on us.

speaker: Juhani
text: You are human... you could not possibly know.

speaker: Player
text: Humans can be just as cruel to each other.

speaker: Juhani
text: That is true I suppose. But it much more obvious for someone like me.

speaker: Juhani
text: There were no other Cathar on Taris. No one to talk to. No one to confide in.

speaker: Juhani
text: Humph! But you must think me weak for saying this. But I am strong enough to admit it!

speaker: Player
text: You are not weak, Juhani. It must have been hard.

speaker: Juhani
text: I thank you for your concern, but...

speaker: Juhani
text: Bah! Maybe I am weak. To think that some stories of my stupid past could possibly interest you.

speaker: Player
text: No, it is alright. I will be here to listen to you whenever you want.

speaker: Juhani
text: I thank you. You are kinder than I would have expected... To put up with me using you in this way.

speaker: Juhani
text: I hope that I will not use your time so badly in the future. Thank you.

speaker: Player
text: It is interesting... I just fail to see the point.

speaker: Juhani
text: Maybe there is no point. Maybe I am just lost after leaving yet another planet. I apologize for my outburst. I will try to control myself next time.

speaker: Player
text: You're right. Don't bother me with this drivel again.

speaker: Juhani
text: I would not have thought you were so cruel as that.

speaker: Player
text: Wait a second. Why are you telling me all this?

speaker: Juhani
text: I... I do not know. I have been keeping it inside for so long. I thought you might understand. You do not seem to fit in exactly with the others. You are... different.

speaker: Player
text: Oh, I'm sorry, were you saying something important?

speaker: Player
text: I find it a little hard to believe.

speaker: Juhani
text: How can you say that? You have seen Taris, you know what kind of a scum infested hole it is.

speaker: Juhani
text: For us there was no respite. No one to turn to.

speaker: Player
text: Well you have to admit: You are a freak.

speaker: Juhani
text: What? You.. You are just like them!

speaker: Player
text: Life is hard. You can't blame everything on other people.

speaker: Juhani
text: But it was precisely the people who made it so bad!

speaker: Player
text: Why are you so hostile towards Canderous?

speaker: Juhani
text: I am wary of the Mandalorian. I do not trust him.
comment: p5  when the player asks about what shes doing (watching canderous)

speaker: Player
text: Wary? Why?

speaker: Juhani
text: I have never trusted Mandalorians. They drove my parents from Cathar, aided the Sith and attacked the Republic. Their warped notions of 'honor' may provoke them to do even more heinous acts.

speaker: Juhani
text: I do not know why you tolerate his presence on your ship. In truth, he has had some merit so far, but I am not certain it is worth the risk you take.

speaker: Player
text: Canderous has proven himself.

speaker: Juhani
text: His kind may prove to be a danger to the galaxy again, but this man himself has proven acceptable so far. Merely keep your distance from him and watch him, so that he does not betray us.

speaker: Player
text: Have you spoken to him?

speaker: Juhani
text: Spoken to him? No! No, I could not.

speaker: Juhani
text: Mandalorians are vicious of temper and easily provoked. I... I would not want to tempt his wrath.

speaker: Player
text: What?? Aren't the Cathar such fierce warriors?

speaker: Juhani
text: I am not a coward! I fear no one and nothing! But you have not had to flee the destruction of your homeworld either, human.

speaker: Juhani
text: The Mandalorians came and overran my world, they slaughtered my race... I cannot forget what they have done. Or forgive.

speaker: Player
text: Hatred and fear lead to the dark side, Juhani.

speaker: Juhani
text: You are right, of course. You always seem to know what you speak of.

speaker: Juhani
text: This simmering anger and hatred for the Mandalores seems to have found a place in my heart, though. Sometimes, I worry...

speaker: Player
text: About what?

speaker: Juhani
text: That I may fall to the dark side once again. That I may threaten you, the Republic... the entire galaxy.

speaker: Juhani
text: If... If that time does come. And if i do threaten our task. It is only right that you should strike me down.

speaker: Juhani
text: Should that time come again, I would rather no one else do it than the one who redeemed me in the first place.

speaker: Juhani
text: But we are becoming too morbid too soon. We should not talk like this now. There is much yet we can do.

speaker: Juhani
text: But we shall talk later I am sure.

speaker: Juhani
text: If I fall and endanger you and the galaxy you must do what is right. If my death will defeat Malak, then that is what must be done.

speaker: Player
text: You should not worry. You can over your anger.

speaker: Juhani
text: But still it eats away at me. I worry that I may yet again fall and endanger everything that I hold dear.

speaker: Player
text: I may be forced to strike you down, should you fall.

speaker: Player
text: I think you will come to trust him in time.

speaker: Juhani
text: Maybe. Maybe not. I cannot forgive them for what they have done to me and my people.

speaker: Juhani
text: In time Canderous may prove himself. But it will not be easy.

speaker: Player
text: I would not let him harm you, Juhani.

speaker: Juhani
text: I can take care of myself! I do not need you to patronize me!

speaker: Juhani
text: But... I thank you for your kind words. It is hard being alone all the time. To be accepted and welcomed is... flattering.

speaker: Juhani
text: But it is gratifying to know that you value me as a companion that much.

speaker: Player
text: A wise decision. We do not need internal conflict.

speaker: Juhani
text: I am sorry. It is just that I cannot stand to be around him for very long. I suppose I do not really dislike him, it is just...

speaker: Player
text: Just?

speaker: Player
text: You are afraid?

speaker: Player
text: Just... that you are a coward. Why deny it?

speaker: Player
text: A cowardly, but rational choice.

speaker: Player
text: Should I speak to him?

speaker: Juhani
text: Speak to him? No, no!

speaker: Player
text: Do not become paranoid, Juhani.

speaker: Juhani
text: I am not paranoid! My suspicions are justified. I dare not speak about it around him, though.

speaker: Player
text: Fear and hate are lures of the dark side.

speaker: Juhani
text: That is true. But also I know his kind. This man he may be different, but...

speaker: Player
text: You should not judge Canderous by other Mandalorians.

speaker: Player
text: Perhaps we will have to eliminate him, then.

speaker: Juhani
text: Eliminate? What? I never proposed to murder the man!

speaker: Player
text: He has proven himself well.

speaker: Player
text: I am suspicious as well.

speaker: Player
text: You're delusional.

speaker: Juhani
text: I am not! They are not to be trusted! They are brutes and savages and destroyers of worlds!

speaker: Player
text: Nothing for now. Perhaps later.

speaker: Juhani
text: Of course. If there is anything else, I am here to help.

speaker: Player
text: What do you know about this world?

speaker: Juhani
text: Dantooine? Dantooine has been my home for a number of years, ever since I started my training with the Jedi.

speaker: Juhani
text: It is a lightly populated planet, mostly focused on agriculture and hunting of the wild beasts that roam its plains.

speaker: Juhani
text: The most populous form of animals on its surface are the iriaz, herd beasts that are normally quite tame, but can be violent when provoked, and the kath hounds, vicious pack predators.

speaker: Juhani
text: Kath hounds do not normally attack people except when it is a pack of them ambushing a lone individual. But recently they have been much more aggressive.

speaker: Juhani
text: I am to blame for that, I believe.

speaker: Juhani
text: But enough of my self-recrimination, I should not dwell on the past, but rather look to the future.

speaker: Juhani
text: How may I be of further assistance to you, Padawan?

speaker: Juhani
text: Manaan is a water-rich world... as you may have been able to tell.

speaker: Juhani
text: With the exception of this Ahto city, there is no land on the world protruding above sea-level.

speaker: Juhani
text: The dominant indigenous race of the world are the Selkath, a semi-aquatic bipedal species. They are known to be very dreary and strong proponents of the power of law above all else.

speaker: Juhani
text: The extremist policies of the Sith seem to appeal to them. They have declared themselves neutral in this conflict between the Republic and the Sith.

speaker: Player
text: Neutral? Can they not see the Sith are evil?

speaker: Juhani
text: The Selkath seek to preserve their independence by maintaining a stranglehold on the one unique resource of their world: the vulnerary liquid Kolto. The most powerful curative in the galaxy.

speaker: Juhani
text: As the only world in the galaxy that produces Kolto, they have positioned themselves between the Sith and the Republic, supplying both sides with the medicine equally.

speaker: Juhani
text: They hope in this way to make themselves too valuable to both to be conquered. As a last resort, they have made it clear to both sides that any attempt to attack their world will force them to destroy the Kolto supply entirely.

speaker: Juhani
text: Any violation by either the Republic or the Sith of their sacrosanct laws incurs severe Kolto export restrictions on the violating government.

speaker: Juhani
text: Both the Republic and the Sith try to keep the Selkath happy and give them no cause to complain. But I wonder how the Sith can take this affront to their power in stride...

speaker: Juhani
text: Many people speak highly of the integrity of the Selkath people... but from what little I have seen of them, they are disgusting little fish-people. But I suppose I just have too high standards.

speaker: Player
text: The Sith seem to have all the advantages.

speaker: Player
text: Yeah, well evil always wins in the end anyway.

speaker: Juhani
text: I am sorry, but I do not know anything about this place. It truly is an unknown world to me. I would be surprised if anyone at all in the Republic knew of it.

speaker: Juhani
text: We should be on our guard at all times.

speaker: Juhani
text: Korriban, I have heard, is a mysterious world. It is rumored to hold many ancient ruins of a purpose that none have been able to discover.

speaker: Juhani
text: There are also tales of strange ghosts and monsters haunting the ruins, whispering in the ears of all who would listen and driving them mad.

speaker: Juhani
text: The Jedi are not welcome here, however, so we cannot determine the truth that may lie in these rumors.

speaker: Juhani
text: Korriban remains staunchly outside the Republic, and we suspect that the Sith may have spread their influence here as well. The large Czerka Corporation outpost also points towards that.

speaker: Juhani
text: If the Czerka Corp. is the industrial arms of the Sith Empire, then judging by the size of their facilities here, this may be a very dangerous world indeed.

speaker: Juhani
text: We must watch ourselves closely here.

speaker: Juhani
text: Tatooine is a filthy desert. Planets such as this should not be fit for life at all. My skin itches just to be here.

speaker: Juhani
text: As you can see, it is a desert. Very little water. Too much sand. This sort of place attracts too much of the seedier side of civilization.

speaker: Juhani
text: As to the particulars of this world itself, I can safely say that it holds no interest for me, and I will be well pleased when we leave here and never return.

speaker: Juhani
text: Now is there something else, or may we hurry and do what we have to do here as quickly as possible?

speaker: Juhani
text: I have heard of this world... Kashyyyk. It is a place of giant trees that have overgrown the entire world, blanketing it in greenery.

speaker: Juhani
text: But while it is beautiful to behold at times, it can also be quite deadly. Many creatures and predators lurk in the leaves and branches. Some small, some undoubtedly quite large.

speaker: Juhani
text: I have heard that the bottom layers of the trees have never been seen by a living being who returned to tell of it, and that travelling there is certain death. I do not envy any who go there.

speaker: Juhani
text: It is most odd that Revan came here, but perhaps in the vast canopy of one of these trees we may find another piece of the Star Map.

speaker: Juhani
text: I have heard of no indigenous race that inhabits this world, but I must profess my ignorance, since I have only heard its name in passing.

speaker: Player
text: I was wondering if you could help me with our stowaway problem.

speaker: Juhani
text: I do not know how to help you with that, I am sorry.

speaker: Player
text: Do you know if anything can be done about all these gizka?

speaker: Player
text: [Don't speak to her.]

speaker: Juhani
text: [You decide to ignore Juhani and continue on with your quest for now, though you might want to speak with her later.]

speaker: Juhani
text: There is no time to talk now. Our priority is to find what caused this disturbance in the Force. It is close by, I know that much.

speaker: Juhani
text: How... how can you possibly be Revan?
comment: p8  if the player approaches juhani after learning he is revan

speaker: Juhani
text: The one... the Jedi whose troops saved me on Taris... It was Revan, leading an army out to defeat the Mandalorians. It was you...
comment: if the player has not already heard her talk about him being revan

speaker: Juhani
text: You are nothing like the one who saved me on Taris.

speaker: Player
text: I am who I am, Juhani.

speaker: Juhani
text: You are obviously not who I thought you were, once upon a time.

speaker: Juhani
text: I thought you were the ideal Jedi. I thought you would never turn against us. Yet here you are.

speaker: Player
text: Here I am.

speaker: Juhani
text: You did turn in the end. I did not want to believe it. But now I suppose you have a chance to redeem yourself.

speaker: Juhani
text: You can work with us. For the Republic. For the Order. We can set right what you started so long ago.

speaker: Player
text: We shall see.

speaker: Juhani
text: Yes we shall. I only hope that you will see this through until the end.

speaker: Juhani
text: Time will tell what choices you make. I shall stay by you to see this task done.

speaker: Player
text: I will do what is necessary.

speaker: Juhani
text: And I hope that what you see as necessary is what we originally set out to do.

speaker: Player
text: I work for myself!

speaker: Juhani
text: Only through serving the Republic do you serve yourself as well. In defeating Malak you save all of us along with you.

speaker: Player
text: I do not make excuses for my actions.

speaker: Player
text: I AM the ideal Jedi.

speaker: Player
text: You know nothing of me!

speaker: Player
text: People change.

speaker: Juhani
text: I knew when I heard that you had become the Dark Lord of the Sith that something was wrong with it.

speaker: Juhani
text: The man who saved me could never go completely to the dark side.

speaker: Player
text: I regret any of the harm I may have caused.

speaker: Juhani
text: It is good to know that you have truly changed. It gives me hope.

speaker: Juhani
text: I do not think now that I will fall to the dark side. I only have to look to you and follow by your example and there is no way I can fail.

speaker: Player
text: Overconfidence can also lead to the dark side.

speaker: Juhani
text: Yes. That is true. I suppose you would know better than I.

speaker: Juhani
text: I will never forget what you did for me, even if you do not remember it.

speaker: Player
text: You will do fine, Juhani.

speaker: Juhani
text: Thank you for placing your confidence in me. I only wish I had your heart as well...

speaker: Juhani
text: That is especially meaningful coming from you.

speaker: Player
text: You flatter me...

speaker: Juhani
text: I... I am sorry, I did not realize. I will endeavor to be more considerate in the future.

speaker: Player
text: I do not know who that Revan was. I am not him.

speaker: Player
text: Perhaps he had his reasons. But I do not.

speaker: Juhani
text: The woman who saved me, who I... I have come to care for, could never go completely to the dark side.

speaker: Player
text: I do not know who that Revan was. I am not her.

text: Perhaps she had her reasons. But I do not.

text: The woman who saved me, who I... who I have come to admire, could never go completely to the dark side.

text: This may be the last time I will have a chance to talk to you...

speaker: Juhani
text: I just want you to know that I... that I...

text: ... Yes?

speaker: Juhani
text: I... I... I care for you. I do not know why. I do not know if anything will be possible or if you even return what I feel, but I do know it is there.

speaker: Juhani
text: I am sorry if this upsets you. I am so sorry if I am wrong, but I cannot deny what it is that I feel.

speaker: Player
text: I feel the same way, Juhani.

speaker: Juhani
text: Now that I have put myself in this position, I know not what to say.

speaker: Player
text: You do not have to say anything.

speaker: Juhani
text: Yes. I thank you.

speaker: Juhani
text: But as much as I may care for you, and you for me, first we must deal with Malak.

speaker: Juhani
text: After there will be time to sort things out between us.

speaker: Player
text: Er... 'Thank you'?

speaker: Player
text: We have gone past words.

speaker: Player
text: I am sorry, I cannot return your affection.

speaker: Juhani
text: I... I understand. You have someone somewhere... or I just do not seem to appeal to you.

speaker: Juhani
text: I am sorry for pushing myself on you. I apologize for my actions.

speaker: Juhani
text: I suggest we find and confront Malak as soon as possible to remove the threat to the Republic once and for all.

speaker: Player
text: Are you sure this is the time for this?

speaker: Juhani
text: I was afraid that I would have no more time to say it... I wonder if all of us wil survive what we must do...

speaker: Player
text: You do not need to say it, Juhani.

speaker: Juhani
text: But I feel I must. I have never said this before...

speaker: Player
text: Please stop. Now.

speaker: Juhani
text: Of.. Of course. I am sorry. I should have known better.

speaker: Juhani
text: I can only say that if I am going to die, as we stand likely to, I am glad that it will be you beside whom I do it.

speaker: Juhani
text: I just want to thank you for all that you have done for me. For saving me from the dark side, for accepting me on your journey.

speaker: Player
text: I value your companionship.

speaker: Juhani
text: It is good to know that I have been of some value...

speaker: Juhani
text: Even if not as much as I would like...

speaker: Juhani
text: I will prove my true worth to you.

speaker: Juhani
text: We WILL defeat Malak and save the Republic from the Sith threat once and for all!

speaker: Player
text: And that is what we shall do!

speaker: Juhani
text: I pledge my life to your cause. I will stand by you until the end.

speaker: Player
text: We should get going.

speaker: Player
text: Do not underestimate the Sith.

speaker: Juhani
text: I... defer to your wisdom in this matter. I have little knowledge of the true power of the Sith.

speaker: Player
text: I need you to help me, Juhani.

speaker: Juhani
text: I will help you in any way I can.

speaker: Player
text: You have proved your worth many times over.

speaker: Juhani
text: So here we are... in the belly of the beast.

speaker: Player
text: What is wrong?

text: Here we are in a Sith Interdicter loaded with troops and Sith Jedi, and you wonder at my apprehension?

speaker: Juhani
text: Knowledge of the almost certainty of my death tends to make me introspective.

speaker: Juhani
text: I wish that I had more time to turn you from the path you seem to have chosen.

speaker: Player
text: The choices I have made were necessary

speaker: Juhani
text: I wonder if that is true. For your sake, I hope that it is.

speaker: Juhani
text: But you have also fallen far from the ideals of the Jedi Order. Can you still do what is required of you?

speaker: Player
text: I WILL defeat Malak!

speaker: Juhani
text: Your conviction is... compelling. But also disturbing.

speaker: Juhani
text: Your steadfast desire for vengeance credits your perseverence, but I fear for you. It is too easy to give in completely to the dark side.

speaker: Juhani
text: I know I worry too much, and I know you may be irritated by my saying this, but do not fall the way I did. You have so much potential, I do not want you to waste it.

speaker: Juhani
text: I only wish that we had had more time... together...

speaker: Player
text: We will have time.

speaker: Juhani
text: It is too late to do anything now. We must do what we can to escape from here.

speaker: Juhani
text: When we have left, perhaps then we can see what the future holds for us.

speaker: Player
text: You are making me uncomfortable...

speaker: Juhani
text: But there is enough to worry about without my making it worse. Perhaps we can speak more of this later, once we leave this ship.

text: When I get out of here, I will hunt Malak down like a dog.

text: I can do anything. Starting with destroying this ship.

text: I do not need you to judge me.

text: If you will not listen to me, then to who? I respect your abilities, and I... I care for you...

text: If you will not listen to me, then to who? I admire you greatly, and respect your abilities...

speaker: Player
text: We will have all the time in the world, Juhani.

text: I hope that is true. Truly, I do.

text: If I am going to die here then, I am glad to have stood by you.

text: I do not favor our chances at all. But if you believe that we can... then maybe there is a possibility.

text: Live or die, I shall stand by you as you need me.

text: Let us leave this place then... If we can.

text: And I am glad to have had you by my side.

text: Do not worry, we will escape.

text: We are in a Sith Interdicter loaded with troops and Sith Jedi. I am not favoring of our chances.

text: I will not let them take me.

text: I feel I must apologize for the way I acted towards you before, in the grove. It was wrong of me.

text: You thought the dark side had consumed you. It is nothing.

speaker: Juhani
text: I hope that by helping you in your task I may redeem myself in your eyes... and in my own.

text: Do not worry, Juhani. I forgive you.

text: Thank you... It is most reassuring to know that you can forgive me, even though I tried to take your life.

speaker: Juhani
text: I can only hope that, in our time journeying together, I will succeed.

text: I think it's going to take a lot for that to happen.

text: It may. But I am prepared to do what it takes.

speaker: Juhani
text: You mock me! I will do what it takes to redeem myself in the eyes of my peers. I WILL succeed!

speaker: Juhani
text: I will prove myself to you and to everyone! I will be a faithful companion to you and Bastila as long as our journey may last.

text: Damn right! Apologize!

text: I thought that too. But I was wrong...

text: My Cathar blood seethes at the thought of that man still running free. I cannot stand still while I think about it, but... but I will not give in to the dark side either.

text: He will pay for his crimes, though. He will most likely be following us... me. If we could find him first, then he may not be able to set in motion whatever he has in store for us.

text: That man was a beast! A monster! I am glad that the galaxy is now rid of him, so that he may not harm others again.
